paper.title: Opinion evolution in closed community
paper.journal: International Journal of Modern Physics C 11(6):1157-1165

headline: Sznajd 2000 (agent-based, 2D): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; complete consensus from d=0.5 in 100% of runs; phase transition at d=1/2 (P(all-UP): 0.00 for d<=0.4 -> 1.00 for d>=0.6)

verdicts.gate: P1 complete consensus from d=0.5 (|m|>=0.95 in >=80% of runs)
P2 phase transition at d=1/2 (P(all-UP)<= 0.05 for d<=0.4, >= 0.95 for d>=0.6)
P3 majority opinion wins (P(all-UP|d=0.7)>0.8 AND P(all-UP|d=0.3)<0.2)

extra.rule_variant: 2D Sznajd 'united we stand': unanimous 2x2 plaquette persuades its 8 edge-adjacent neighbours (Stauffer 2000 generalisation); periodic lattice; frozen-sweep stop
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic opinion-dynamics model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce consensus + the d=1/2 transition and would catch an artifact

citations: Sznajd-Weron, K. & Sznajd, J. (2000). Opinion evolution in closed community. Int. J. Mod. Phys. C 11(6):1157-1165. doi:10.1142/S0129183100000936.
Stauffer, D., Sousa, A.O. & Moss de Oliveira, S. (2000). Generalization to square lattice of Sznajd sociophysics model. Int. J. Mod. Phys. C 11(6):1239-1245.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction
